description: Source code for 'git var' command, managing and displaying various Git configuration and environment variables.

classes.name: git_var
classes.description: Structure representing a Git variable with its name, read function, and multivalued flag.

methods.name: committer
methods.description: Returns the committer information string or null.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author information string or null.

methods.name: editor
methods.description: Returns the editor command string or null.

methods.name: sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the sequence editor command string or null.

methods.name: pager
methods.description: Returns the pager program to use, defaulting to 'cat' if none configured.

methods.name: default_branch
methods.description: Returns the default branch name of the repository.

methods.name: shell_path
methods.description: Returns the shell path used by Git.

methods.name: git_attr_val_system
methods.description: Returns the system attribute file path if enabled.

methods.name: git_attr_val_global
methods.description: Returns the global attribute file path.

methods.name: git_config_val_system
methods.description: Returns the system Git config file path.

methods.name: git_config_val_global
methods.description: Returns the global Git config paths.

methods.name: list_vars
methods.description: Lists all Git variables and their current values.

methods.name: get_git_var
methods.description: Retrieves the git_var structure for a given variable name.

methods.name: show_config
methods.description: Displays a configuration variable and its value.

methods.name: cmd_var
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git var' command, handling arguments and output.
